title: Tax Document Analysis with AI
description: Full ML pipeline for tax document analysis, integrating OCR, NLP classification models, Llama fine-tuning, and local models. Joint project with FINEP and SUFRAMA.

title: SKU Segmentation and Classification
description: Computer vision system for SKU segmentation and classification from mobile photos, automating product identification and pricing with a 40% increase in operational efficiency.

title: RAG System for Help Desk
description: End-to-end RAG system with LangChain, integrating vector databases, relational databases, and corporate APIs (SAP, ServiceNow, jurisprudence) for help desk ticket automation.

title: Domain Adaptation in Computer Vision
description: Research on domain adaptation techniques applied to computer vision tasks, aiming to improve model generalization across different data distributions.

title: Computer Vision with Limited Data
description: Exploration of strategies to train computer vision models in low-data scenarios, including data augmentation and transfer learning.
